key_insight: IteraSim RAG makes OpenFOAM case generation more reliable by splitting retrieval into specialized query variants and splitting generation into distinct architect, writer, and reviewer agents.
engineering_relevance: This reduces the manual burden of assembling consistent CFD input decks, making open-source CFD workflows easier for non-specialists to configure and debug.
method: LLM expands each request into physics, solver-keyword, and troubleshooting queries.
Reciprocal Rank Fusion combines ranked results, then Maximal Marginal Relevance re-ranks them from an HNSW dense vector store.
A deterministic router and three-agent workflow use a canonical knowledge layer for solver choice, turbulence, boundary conditions, and defaults.
evidence_signal: On a 28-case OpenFOAM benchmark, the system achieved 77.9% mean retrieval coverage, all six reference configurations ran successfully on v2506, and two corrupted cases were repaired within the Reviewer loop.
watch_item: Performance depends on the quality of the canonical knowledge layer and bounded review loop, so unfamiliar physics or weak corpus coverage may still produce incorrect case setups.
paper_title: IteraSim RAG: A Multi-Stage Retrieval-Augmented Agentic Back-End for OpenFOAM-Based Computational Fluid Dynamics
